defrag84-mcp.description: Model Context Protocol bridge allowing external Kiro agents to monitor live virtual heap fragmentation, trigger autonomous 2D bin-packing GC compactions, and inject chaos workloads.

tools.name: get_heap_telemetry
tools.description: Returns current virtual heap memory statistics: fragmentation ratio, reclaimed MB, heap pressure, OOM alerts, and 10x20 allocation matrix.

tools.name: suggest_move
tools.description: Uses Pierre Dellacherie 2D bin-packing heuristics to calculate optimal page frame compaction placement.

tools.name: inject_chaos_load
tools.description: Allows Chaos Monkey daemon to inject memory leaks (fog_of_war), context switches (poltergeist_shift), pointer inversions (soul_inversion), or bit rot (tombstone_crumble).

tools.name: get_board_state
tools.description: Returns raw matrix grid, active memory allocation frame, and upcoming page pipeline.
